input.title: [iOS Capacitor] Thought is moved when user put cursor on the first thought
input.body:
```
- A
- B
- C
```

## Step to Reproduce
1. Tap B
2. Tap A
3. Tap Home button

## Current behavior
Thought is moved up when user set the cursor on A
Thought is moved down when user sets cursor to null / root

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c360bc06-8bc8-475f-89f6-da0a67abbc84

## Expected behavior
Thought should not be static.
Refer to the behavior of Mobile Safari
